sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "wine"."Appelation" AS e, "appellations"."County" AS g, AVG((CAST("wine"."Price" AS REAL) / "wine"."Score")) AS m1 FROM "wine" JOIN "appellations" ON "appellations"."Appelation" = "wine"."Appelation"  GROUP BY "wine"."Appelation", "appellations"."County"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
quantities: wine.bottle price per critic rating score
why: bottle price / critic rating score: the catalogue declares bottle price a rate over critic rating score
average of bottle price per critic rating score per appellations within appellations.County
gap to the all average of average of bottle price per critic rating score (all level)
rank within the group by average of bottle price per critic rating score, keep the top 3
